text: 'May know how my heart went with them... after the red-rose-bordered hem.'

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]I knew they wouldn't come looking for anyone under a pile of Catastrophe rubble.
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: I knew they wouldn't come looking for anyone under a pile of Catastrophe rubble.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]We have that thick mist this morning to thank. Wouldn't have made it out so easily otherwise.
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: We have that thick mist this morning to thank. Wouldn't have made it out so easily otherwise.

raw: [name="Reed"]Ah, careful. We don't have any protective equipment. There's a risk of infection here, if we get hurt.
speaker: Reed
content: Ah, careful. We don't have any protective equipment. There's a risk of infection here, if we get hurt.

raw: [name="Reed"]You too, Moran. Originium-rich environments are—especially dangerous to Infected.
speaker: Reed
content: You too, Moran. Originium-rich environments are—especially dangerous to Infected.

speaker: Moran
content: Noted. I'll watch out.

speaker: Reed
content: Is Caireann... asleep?

raw: [name="Moran"]I think she's just fallen asleep, yes, it wasn't fainting. Her breathing's very calm, I can tell. Sleep will ease her pain, if only by a little.
speaker: Moran
content: I think she's just fallen asleep, yes, it wasn't fainting. Her breathing's very calm, I can tell. Sleep will ease her pain, if only by a little.

raw: [name="Moran"]But I still worry she might not make it, if we don't stop to take care of her injuries soon.
speaker: Moran
content: But I still worry she might not make it, if we don't stop to take care of her injuries soon.

speaker: Reed
content: Mm.

speaker: Reed
content: Are... any of you disappointed?

raw: [name="Moran"]Why would we be? Didn't you say so yourself? We've got to fight with Dublinn forces because they don't want a second 'Leader.'
speaker: Moran
content: Why would we be? Didn't you say so yourself? We've got to fight with Dublinn forces because they don't want a second 'Leader.'

raw: [name="Moran"]But they've got grander goals. They won't keep making chase.
speaker: Moran
content: But they've got grander goals. They won't keep making chase.

raw: [name="Moran"]We're used to a life of running at this point. We can bear with it.
speaker: Moran
content: We're used to a life of running at this point. We can bear with it.

raw: [name="Moran"]What about after, though? You still haven't told us what you're thinking for then.
speaker: Moran
content: What about after, though? You still haven't told us what you're thinking for then.

raw: [name="Reed"]I don't have a very good idea yet. I'm sorry.
speaker: Reed
content: I don't have a very good idea yet. I'm sorry.

raw: [name="Reed"]Right. There might be fewer Originium crystals, deeper into the ruins. I want to take a look, and see if we can hide ourselves anywhere for the moment.
speaker: Reed
content: Right. There might be fewer Originium crystals, deeper into the ruins. I want to take a look, and see if we can hide ourselves anywhere for the moment.

raw: [name="Reed"]It's about time we all stopped for some rest.
speaker: Reed
content: It's about time we all stopped for some rest.

raw: [name="Moran"]But aren't there people over that way?
speaker: Moran
content: But aren't there people over that way?

raw: [name="Moran"]They seem like normal folk, but we should steer clear anyhow. You said yourself, it's strange there's people in a place like this. We need to be careful...
speaker: Moran
content: They seem like normal folk, but we should steer clear anyhow. You said yourself, it's strange there's people in a place like this. We need to be careful...

speaker: Reed
content: No need.

raw: [name="Moran"]...You seem so afraid. What's the matter?
speaker: Moran
content: ...You seem so afraid. What's the matter?

raw: [name="Reed"]I'm fine. Please, don't worry about me.
speaker: Reed
content: I'm fine. Please, don't worry about me.

raw: [name="Reed"](She's come here before...? Is she nearby?)
speaker: Reed
content: (She's come here before...? Is she nearby?)

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]Hey. The one over there's walking kind of strange, isn't she?
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Hey. The one over there's walking kind of strange, isn't she?

speaker: Reed
content: Don't look.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Oh, lord—she's—

speaker: Reed
content: She probably died—some time ago.

raw: [name="Reed"]Her body's—just being controlled by Arts. Like the Dublinn soldiers we saw before.
speaker: Reed
content: Her body's—just being controlled by Arts. Like the Dublinn soldiers we saw before.

speaker: Moran
content: Why would they control a civilian?

speaker: Reed
content: I'm not sure yet.

raw: [name="Reed"]—Come with me. I'll handle these dead.
speaker: Reed
content: —Come with me. I'll handle these dead.

raw: [name="Reed"]It's very dim here. Follow the stone steps—watch out for any shards of raw crystal as you go down... Moran, are you sure you're okay carrying Caireann on your back?
speaker: Reed
content: It's very dim here. Follow the stone steps—watch out for any shards of raw crystal as you go down... Moran, are you sure you're okay carrying Caireann on your back?

raw: [name="Moran"]I'm fine. As long as your flame's lit, I can see where I'm going.
speaker: Moran
content: I'm fine. As long as your flame's lit, I can see where I'm going.

raw: [name="Reed"]Okay. We'll head in as deep as we can. Try not to be too loud.
speaker: Reed
content: Okay. We'll head in as deep as we can. Try not to be too loud.

speaker: Moran
content: It's...
King Gaeil's castle?

raw: [backgroundTween(xFrom=100, yFrom=0, xTo=-100, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.3, yScaleFrom=1.3, xScaleTo=1.3, yScaleTo=1.3, duration=20, block=false)]

When the topic of that overthrown dynasty arises, some think of the piles upon piles of armor from fallen soldiers, while others claim its golden crown still hides beneath elaborate mechanisms, deep within the ancient forest.
content: When the topic of that overthrown dynasty arises, some think of the piles upon piles of armor from fallen soldiers, while others claim its golden crown still hides beneath elaborate mechanisms, deep within the ancient forest.

raw: Some see the towering walls of modern Victoria as a foil to the castle's vastness, paralleling the boundless inland sea of Clariside with the virtuous prosperity of the age of heroes, while at the same time lamenting its passing decay under the shadow of Victoria.
content: Some see the towering walls of modern Victoria as a foil to the castle's vastness, paralleling the boundless inland sea of Clariside with the virtuous prosperity of the age of heroes, while at the same time lamenting its passing decay under the shadow of Victoria.

raw: All have envisioned this ancient castle as a sorrowful tombstone to Tara, the ghost of resentment.
content: All have envisioned this ancient castle as a sorrowful tombstone to Tara, the ghost of resentment.

raw: But it merely sits silent, on top of the hill, baring this place's heart as it was before the palace stood.
content: But it merely sits silent, on top of the hill, baring this place's heart as it was before the palace stood.

raw: Overgrown with weeds, covered in vines.
content: Overgrown with weeds, covered in vines.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]How old is all this? Five hundred years? A thousand?
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: How old is all this? Five hundred years? A thousand?

speaker: Moran
content: Shh... Don't wake Caireann up.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]Sorry... I'm just a little shocked. No, bowled over, really.
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Sorry... I'm just a little shocked. No, bowled over, really.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]Tell you the truth. We put on productions of different King Gaeil stories each year, we know we're descendants of the Kingdom of Tara, we know that's why we're called Tarans...
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Tell you the truth. We put on productions of different King Gaeil stories each year, we know we're descendants of the Kingdom of Tara, we know that's why we're called Tarans...

raw: [name="Moran"]But no one used to believe it could all actually be true.
speaker: Moran
content: But no one used to believe it could all actually be true.

raw: [name="Moran"]There was even a legend of a forge, which fused together the weapons of every Taran soldier, and overturned the fate of the dynasty...
speaker: Moran
content: There was even a legend of a forge, which fused together the weapons of every Taran soldier, and overturned the fate of the dynasty...

raw: [name="Moran"]A long, long time ago... I met a man from the city who was searching all over for a traveling bard.
speaker: Moran
content: A long, long time ago... I met a man from the city who was searching all over for a traveling bard.

raw: [name="Moran"]He said to me, though many legends were made up by later generations, there must still be the traces of history left in those stories.
speaker: Moran
content: He said to me, though many legends were made up by later generations, there must still be the traces of history left in those stories.

raw: [name="Moran"]Reed, you must know plenty about that, don't you?
speaker: Moran
content: Reed, you must know plenty about that, don't you?

raw: [name="Moran"]Are you not fond of this place? You've been quiet ever since we came in here.
speaker: Moran
content: Are you not fond of this place? You've been quiet ever since we came in here.

speaker: Reed
content: Maybe.

raw: [name="Reed"]When I was very young, I'd often read about the legends of Tara, until I drifted to sleep.
speaker: Reed
content: When I was very young, I'd often read about the legends of Tara, until I drifted to sleep.

raw: [name="Reed"]Be it the Victorian Royal Family's scribes, or those who wish to preserve Taran culture, they always write that it is the Draco's nature to fight.
speaker: Reed
content: Be it the Victorian Royal Family's scribes, or those who wish to preserve Taran culture, they always write that it is the Draco's nature to fight.

raw: Legends say that the first Draco to lead the Gaeils boiled dry the waters of the river to travel south, to flee his clan that slaughtered each other over the throne, and settle the lands that came to be Tara.
content: Legends say that the first Draco to lead the Gaeils boiled dry the waters of the river to travel south, to flee his clan that slaughtered each other over the throne, and settle the lands that came to be Tara.

raw: And legends say the Victoria's Red Dragon, the one who slayed the last nomadic Draco leader, gave his firstborn the title of King Gaeil while he still burbled in the cradle.
content: And legends say the Victoria's Red Dragon, the one who slayed the last nomadic Draco leader, gave his firstborn the title of King Gaeil while he still burbled in the cradle.

raw: And legends say the Draco of Tara was thereupon imprisoned in the palace, and though the 'Exile King' cast away his crown and traveled the wilderness for twenty years, upon his return and audience with the regent, his closest family, still he was murdered.
content: And legends say the Draco of Tara was thereupon imprisoned in the palace, and though the 'Exile King' cast away his crown and traveled the wilderness for twenty years, upon his return and audience with the regent, his closest family, still he was murdered.

raw: [name="Reed"]Tara's history is full of—stories like these. The Draco's palaces, teeming with conspiracy and bloodshed.
speaker: Reed
content: Tara's history is full of—stories like these. The Draco's palaces, teeming with conspiracy and bloodshed.

raw: [name="Reed"]I never longed for, or dreamed of this place. I'm... scared of it.
speaker: Reed
content: I never longed for, or dreamed of this place. I'm... scared of it.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I'm scared that—one day, I'll have to fight my sister.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I'm scared that—one day, I'll have to fight my sister.

raw: [name="Reed"]At least... I don't see any crystal clusters from the Catastrophe in here.
speaker: Reed
content: At least... I don't see any crystal clusters from the Catastrophe in here.

raw: [name="Reed"]It should be safe to rest here.
speaker: Reed
content: It should be safe to rest here.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]Good, then. Here, Moran. Let me set Caireann down for you.
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Good, then. Here, Moran. Let me set Caireann down for you.

raw: [name="Moran"]Let her sleep here, out of the wind.
speaker: Moran
content: Let her sleep here, out of the wind.

raw: [name="Moran"]There's cover here, and the walls are sturdy. We could light a fire at night, and no one outside would notice us.
speaker: Moran
content: There's cover here, and the walls are sturdy. We could light a fire at night, and no one outside would notice us.

speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Wait, why's Reed—

raw: [name="Moran"]Let her take a look by herself.
speaker: Moran
content: Let her take a look by herself.

raw: [Subtitle(text="'I lay down now my soldier's honor here, so that in time the soil of Tara need no longer be soaked in carmine blood, and Draco cross no swords with Draco kin.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'I lay down now my soldier's honor here, so that in time the soil of Tara need no longer be soaked in carmine blood, and Draco cross no swords with Draco kin.'

raw: [Subtitle(text="'Be that unless a day comes, whereupon Red Dragon's flame should lead all those that fell, our fighters from the forge to be reborn.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'Be that unless a day comes, whereupon Red Dragon's flame should lead all those that fell, our fighters from the forge to be reborn.'

content: Reed hears a faint stir.

raw: She pulls back the hand about to touch the rusted equipment before her.
content: She pulls back the hand about to touch the rusted equipment before her.

speaker: Reed
content: It's... alive?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]It's the sort of thing anyone could activate... Why do you find it so strange someone relit it?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: It's the sort of thing anyone could activate... Why do you find it so strange someone relit it?

raw: [name="Reed"]Mm. She's been through here. It's not strange.
speaker: Reed
content: Mm. She's been through here. It's not strange.

raw: Through a gap, she sees a purple flame.
content: Through a gap, she sees a purple flame.

raw: [name="Reed"]This was the palace of old. She was sure to come... and sure to mock it with laughter, no? That this... is all the legendary monarch—left us with.
speaker: Reed
content: This was the palace of old. She was sure to come... and sure to mock it with laughter, no? That this... is all the legendary monarch—left us with.

raw: [name="Reed"]Her flames burn here. That's why so many of the deceased here cannot rest in peace.
speaker: Reed
content: Her flames burn here. That's why so many of the deceased here cannot rest in peace.

raw: [name="Reed"]They were simply—vagabonds who lost their way, and died of thirst too close. Awakened by the flames of death, for no reason at all.
speaker: Reed
content: They were simply—vagabonds who lost their way, and died of thirst too close. Awakened by the flames of death, for no reason at all.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: No... stay away.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]You're scared of that flame, too, aren't you?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: You're scared of that flame, too, aren't you?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I can see how you want to put it out.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I can see how you want to put it out.

raw: [name="Reed"]Yes. It will bring pain to too many people.
speaker: Reed
content: Yes. It will bring pain to too many people.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]But if you truly intend on it, then I won't let you pass.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: But if you truly intend on it, then I won't let you pass.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]She lit the fire of Dublinn. You know the flame you reignite could never be the same.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: She lit the fire of Dublinn. You know the flame you reignite could never be the same.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]She's done so many terrible things, told so many beautiful lies, but it was all necessary. She summoned thousands of Tarans to follow her lead, be they saints or criminals, nobles or thieves.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: She's done so many terrible things, told so many beautiful lies, but it was all necessary. She summoned thousands of Tarans to follow her lead, be they saints or criminals, nobles or thieves.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: You could never do it.

speaker: Reed
content: No... I can.

raw: [name="Reed"]I don't believe—that those sacrifices were all necessary, and I will never believe—that only her way will save the Tarans.
speaker: Reed
content: I don't believe—that those sacrifices were all necessary, and I will never believe—that only her way will save the Tarans.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]But she's been the Leader since the start, since so long ago, since that great fire in Oak Grove.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: But she's been the Leader since the start, since so long ago, since that great fire in Oak Grove.

raw: She thinks back to the battered, wounded girl who laid there on the street. Reed wanted to pull her up, get her away, but was so afraid that by a reach of the hand, she too would become naught but ashes.
content: She thinks back to the battered, wounded girl who laid there on the street. Reed wanted to pull her up, get her away, but was so afraid that by a reach of the hand, she too would become naught but ashes.

raw: And there, her elder sister walked up to the girl's side.
content: And there, her elder sister walked up to the girl's side.

raw: And asked. Do you want to live?
content: And asked. Do you want to live?

raw: The sewers are right beside you. Climb down there, and those disgusting nobles will never catch you again.
content: The sewers are right beside you. Climb down there, and those disgusting nobles will never catch you again.

raw: Mandragora. From there she escaped, and to there, in the end, she returned.
content: Mandragora. From there she escaped, and to there, in the end, she returned.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]While you—never did reach your hand to anyone. Never pulled anyone up.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: While you—never did reach your hand to anyone. Never pulled anyone up.

raw: [name="Reed"]Mm. If I'd reached out to her, then perhaps, things would have been different.
speaker: Reed
content: Mm. If I'd reached out to her, then perhaps, things would have been different.

raw: [name="Reed"]To be truly saved, she should have learned—that there was so much more open to her... so much more—than the power of the malefactor, like the arsonist of that day.
speaker: Reed
content: To be truly saved, she should have learned—that there was so much more open to her... so much more—than the power of the malefactor, like the arsonist of that day.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Yet the fact is, you're so afraid, you even fear your own power, unable to do anything but let others control it.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Yet the fact is, you're so afraid, you even fear your own power, unable to do anything but let others control it.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]That's why... they're all disappointed in you. Why you've disappointed even your sister.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: That's why... they're all disappointed in you. Why you've disappointed even your sister.

raw: [name="Reed"]...No. You're wrong. You speak of nothing but the past.
speaker: Reed
content: ...No. You're wrong. You speak of nothing but the past.

raw: [name="Reed"]I am here now. I have held others' hands in mine.
speaker: Reed
content: I am here now. I have held others' hands in mine.

raw: [name="Reed"]I cannot say it was me that pulled them to their feet, but if they want to walk forward, then my fire will clear the path for them. Even if they lead me with them as they go.
speaker: Reed
content: I cannot say it was me that pulled them to their feet, but if they want to walk forward, then my fire will clear the path for them. Even if they lead me with them as they go.

raw: [name="Reed"]If... If she could see all this, I know she wouldn't be disappointed.
speaker: Reed
content: If... If she could see all this, I know she wouldn't be disappointed.

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]You... found your companions by mere chance.
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: You... found your companions by mere chance.

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]In front of them, you act like the capable fighter, the orator who brings all under your banner... You pretend to have your own power.
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: In front of them, you act like the capable fighter, the orator who brings all under your banner... You pretend to have your own power.

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]But in reality, you are simply mimicking her.
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: But in reality, you are simply mimicking her.

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]You are nothing, can be nothing, but her shadow. She sees any method through to its extreme, while in the face of her, you are far too hesitant and weak.
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: You are nothing, can be nothing, but her shadow. She sees any method through to its extreme, while in the face of her, you are far too hesitant and weak.

raw: The officers that set light to the Taran districts spring to her mind. They were boisterous in ridiculing the Tarans for their arrogance, for their protesting against injustice in Oak Grove even though they could barely read and write.
content: The officers that set light to the Taran districts spring to her mind. They were boisterous in ridiculing the Tarans for their arrogance, for their protesting against injustice in Oak Grove even though they could barely read and write.

raw: She knows. This is the very thing her sister told their teacher, that this was bound to happen.
content: She knows. This is the very thing her sister told their teacher, that this was bound to happen.

raw: The Victorians lit the flame of hatred by their own hands. This great fire will burn, until all is reduced to nothing.
content: The Victorians lit the flame of hatred by their own hands. This great fire will burn, until all is reduced to nothing.

raw: Don't blink, her sister told her. Witness clearly for yourself how our lives are destroyed again and again.
content: Don't blink, her sister told her. Witness clearly for yourself how our lives are destroyed again and again.

raw: Amidst the sea of charred corpses, the Draco who controls the fires of death lifts her hand to cast.
content: Amidst the sea of charred corpses, the Draco who controls the fires of death lifts her hand to cast.

raw: A purple, ice-cold blaze immediately consumes the flames that had scorched the dead.
content: A purple, ice-cold blaze immediately consumes the flames that had scorched the dead.

raw: That deathly blaze never was a true life-taker. She simply permits they climb from the ashes, to take revenge against those who destroyed their homeland.
content: That deathly blaze never was a true life-taker. She simply permits they climb from the ashes, to take revenge against those who destroyed their homeland.

speaker: Reed
content: ...I have no regrets.

raw: [name="Reed"]I had always once thought she was in the right.
speaker: Reed
content: I had always once thought she was in the right.

raw: [name="Reed"]'We will throw ourselves into the fire, give even our own lives as fuel, to build the Tarans' ideal nation in the end...'
speaker: Reed
content: 'We will throw ourselves into the fire, give even our own lives as fuel, to build the Tarans' ideal nation in the end...'

raw: [name="Reed"]So I always spoke, by her side.
speaker: Reed
content: So I always spoke, by her side.

raw: [name="Reed"]But once the fuel has burned away... will there be anyone left in her nation?
speaker: Reed
content: But once the fuel has burned away... will there be anyone left in her nation?

speaker: Reed
content: I've hesitated, rethought, run away...

speaker: Reed
content: I do not regret it.

raw: [name="Reed"]My flight took me here. I've met people, seen things, she's never seen. The things I want to say cannot be what she does.
speaker: Reed
content: My flight took me here. I've met people, seen things, she's never seen. The things I want to say cannot be what she does.

raw: [name="Reed"]So I will not be afraid of the thought of her again.
speaker: Reed
content: So I will not be afraid of the thought of her again.

raw: [name="Reed"]I will never... be trapped within my own shadow!
speaker: Reed
content: I will never... be trapped within my own shadow!

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]But as you recognized this palace, were you not fearing?
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: But as you recognized this palace, were you not fearing?

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]I imagine you'd never be able to tell your 'companions' where you are bound, but the answer has long been readied in your heart.
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: I imagine you'd never be able to tell your 'companions' where you are bound, but the answer has long been readied in your heart.

raw: [name="'The Leader'"]If you won't become me, then how will you find your own place within Dublinn's dreams?
speaker: 'The Leader'
content: If you won't become me, then how will you find your own place within Dublinn's dreams?

speaker: Eblana
content: —Loughshinny... what do you want?

raw: And in Reed's mind are the dead who walk to them in the great fire.
content: And in Reed's mind are the dead who walk to them in the great fire.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Stop.

raw: Battered, bruised, scarred beyond recognition, yet with their thirst burning bright in their eyes.
content: Battered, bruised, scarred beyond recognition, yet with their thirst burning bright in their eyes.

raw: Their revenge against the Victorian officers fulfilled, now walking to those who lit their flames.
content: Their revenge against the Victorian officers fulfilled, now walking to those who lit their flames.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Walk no longer...

speaker: Loughshinny
content: You are owed... your rest!

raw: —By the time she reacts, those closest to her have fallen before her, the vacant sockets of their eyes all focused on her.
content: —By the time she reacts, those closest to her have fallen before her, the vacant sockets of their eyes all focused on her.

raw: In the fierce flash of her firelight, the deathly flames are extinguished.
content: In the fierce flash of her firelight, the deathly flames are extinguished.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...I'm sorry, Sister. I'm sorry...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I—did not mean to ruin your Arts...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I—did not mean to ruin your Arts...

speaker: Eblana
content: —You've done well, Loughshinny.

raw: She lifts her head in fear.
content: She lifts her head in fear.

raw: For the very first time, her sister is smiling on her in commendation.
content: For the very first time, her sister is smiling on her in commendation.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Truly, very well. Your firelight is such a dazzling one.
speaker: Eblana
content: Truly, very well. Your firelight is such a dazzling one.

raw: [name="Eblana"]I always wondered. What it would take, for you to show your true strength? For you to draw the attentions of all?
speaker: Eblana
content: I always wondered. What it would take, for you to show your true strength? For you to draw the attentions of all?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Display to me your talent once again. Let me see that you truly can drive back my flames.
speaker: Eblana
content: Display to me your talent once again. Let me see that you truly can drive back my flames.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Will you defeat me, my beloved sister?
speaker: Eblana
content: Will you defeat me, my beloved sister?
